_meta.description: Four lists used to flag content for review: wall_1_triggers (the brand's first hygiene wall, typically regulatory), wall_2_triggers (the brand's second hygiene wall, typically strategic positioning), never_name_brands (reference brands that live in evidence files only - never appear in customer copy), voice_register_refs (cadence-only references, not category competitors).
_meta.edit_instructions: Edit this file directly when a new trigger word emerges. After any change, run `python3 tools/marketing_brain.py rebuild-index` to refresh the index. Triggers match case-insensitively as substrings.
